purpose.note: The first viewport names the personal research-library job, the serious-reader audience, article and PDF inputs, and the path from capture to retrieval. The page clearly distinguishes browser-local use, Google sign-in, source-built extension availability, and the absence of checkout.

design.note: The warm editorial research-desk system, detailed Reader workspace, restrained rust accent, fine rules, and compact utility labels are specific to close reading rather than generic SaaS. Exact 390, 768, and 1440 CSS-pixel captures show intentional reflow with no horizontal overflow.

seo.note: The full local Worker candidate passes title, description, canonical, social metadata, JSON-LD, headings, content depth, robots, sitemap reference, and sitemap coverage. The link graph has zero broken or redirecting internal targets; app and utility routes remain intentionally outside the three-page marketing sitemap.

geo.note: The full Worker candidate passes every Fleet agent-index contract through the public tunnel. Production is A/90 because one of four catalog surfaces is stale until a separately authorized release.

performance.note: All twenty Lighthouse audits completed. Every profile scores 100 with zero CLS, zero TBT, and no actionable Lighthouse opportunity; even the slow-3G low-end Android profile remains comfortably within the good LCP band.

verification.primaryJourney: A visitor can understand the capture-to-reading loop, open the browser-local library or a sample, and distinguish account-backed use from public product discovery without encountering invented pricing or distribution claims.
verification.repositoryCheck: TypeScript has no errors; 29 focused route and agent-surface tests pass; the complete SPA plus Astro overlay builds; documentation checks pass.
verification.seoAudit: 18 passed, 0 failed, 0 warnings; internal link graph has zero errors or redirects.
verification.agentIndex: Candidate S-tier at 100 through the public tunnel; production A-tier at 90.

footer.note: The Ask AI loader uses data-compose=false and preserves the explicitly mounted Fleet project strip.

limitations: No deployment, commit, push, DNS change, account action, database mutation, or production configuration change was performed.
The local Worker started with the repository's existing local development configuration; no secret value or environment file was read or changed by the audit.
The temporary Cloudflare quick tunnel has no uptime guarantee and exists only to review the current local candidate.
INP requires field interaction data and is not measured by Lighthouse navigation mode; production RUM or CrUX remains the appropriate field-data source.
